# AshTui v0.3.3 - Table of Contents

> Terminal-based interactive explorer for Ash Framework applications

## Pages

- [Overview](https://ash-tui.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)
- [Contributing](https://ash-tui.hexdocs.pm/contributing.md)
- [Changelog](https://ash-tui.hexdocs.pm/changelog.md)

## Modules

- Core
  - [AshTui](https://ash-tui.hexdocs.pm/AshTui.md): Terminal-based interactive explorer for Ash Framework applications.
  - [AshTui.App](https://ash-tui.hexdocs.pm/AshTui.App.md): Main TUI application using `ExRatatui.App` behaviour.

- Introspection
  - [AshTui.Introspection](https://ash-tui.hexdocs.pm/AshTui.Introspection.md): Loads Ash domain and resource metadata into a navigable data structure.
  - [AshTui.Introspection.ActionInfo](https://ash-tui.hexdocs.pm/AshTui.Introspection.ActionInfo.md): Holds introspection data for a resource action.
  - [AshTui.Introspection.ArgumentInfo](https://ash-tui.hexdocs.pm/AshTui.Introspection.ArgumentInfo.md): Holds introspection data for an action argument.
  - [AshTui.Introspection.AttributeInfo](https://ash-tui.hexdocs.pm/AshTui.Introspection.AttributeInfo.md): Holds introspection data for a resource attribute.
  - [AshTui.Introspection.DomainInfo](https://ash-tui.hexdocs.pm/AshTui.Introspection.DomainInfo.md): Holds introspection data for a single Ash domain.
  - [AshTui.Introspection.RelationshipInfo](https://ash-tui.hexdocs.pm/AshTui.Introspection.RelationshipInfo.md): Holds introspection data for a resource relationship.
  - [AshTui.Introspection.ResourceInfo](https://ash-tui.hexdocs.pm/AshTui.Introspection.ResourceInfo.md): Holds introspection data for a single Ash resource.

- State
  - [AshTui.State](https://ash-tui.hexdocs.pm/AshTui.State.md): State struct and pure navigation logic for the Ash TUI explorer.

- Rendering
  - [AshTui.Format](https://ash-tui.hexdocs.pm/AshTui.Format.md): Shared formatting helpers for display in the TUI.

  - [AshTui.Theme](https://ash-tui.hexdocs.pm/AshTui.Theme.md): Color, style, and rich-text constants for the TUI.
  - [AshTui.Views.ActionsTab](https://ash-tui.hexdocs.pm/AshTui.Views.ActionsTab.md): Actions tab view: table showing resource actions.
  - [AshTui.Views.AttributeDetail](https://ash-tui.hexdocs.pm/AshTui.Views.AttributeDetail.md): Overlay view showing full details for a selected attribute.

  - [AshTui.Views.AttributesTab](https://ash-tui.hexdocs.pm/AshTui.Views.AttributesTab.md): Attributes tab view: table showing resource attributes.
  - [AshTui.Views.NavPanel](https://ash-tui.hexdocs.pm/AshTui.Views.NavPanel.md): Left panel view: domain list with expanded resources, with optional search.
  - [AshTui.Views.RelationshipsTab](https://ash-tui.hexdocs.pm/AshTui.Views.RelationshipsTab.md): Relationships tab view: table showing resource relationships.

## Mix Tasks

- Mix Tasks
  - [mix ash.tui](https://ash-tui.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Ash.Tui.md): Starts an interactive terminal explorer for your Ash domains and resources.
